title: A current-root committed run whose verification record Engram terminally refused has no supported evaluation disposition
outcome:
Raised by Engram::Fable (TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #8775, 2026-11-25 03:35Z) for Engram's w-6ea6f92ccffc (Fix8). Its launcher FULL test-0d4ba2d4 passed 12/12, eligible, on clean d8309928. Engram then terminally refused its verification record: field work_revision, after a label-only edit (Engram w-8d0243f80d1a, P0). Greg vetoed a rerun of the green FULL („NIE!!!”, Asistant 588693a8 #2684).

Code facts (Termal::Fable2, read-only):
- Once a claim has a registered committed-input run, acceptance evaluations follow the committed flow (src/acceptance_committed_input.rs header).
- Admission requires an Engram-acknowledged record, Received or Settled. A TestRunVerificationAck::Rejected refuses with verification_record_not_acknowledged "rejected: …" (src/acceptance_committed_input.rs:491-492).
- A terminal refusal is never resent (docs/test.md:1228-1237).
- The only disposition path, retiredCheckDispositions (src/acceptance_evaluation_api.rs:1837-1875), discloses checks of RETIRED roots as context without credit. It does not cover a current-root run.
So the item can only be evaluated after a new registered run of the same commit, which is exactly the repeat Greg rejected.

Wanted: a supported, host-recorded disposition for a current-root committed run whose record Engram terminally refused. The requester names the run and a reason. The host checks that the run passed eligibly and cleanly on the root's current HEAD and that its record state is the host's own Rejected. It records a disclosure note, as the retired-check disposition does, and admits the evaluation with that run as context only and no verification credit. A criterion bound to a check kind still needs a registered record. The disposition never satisfies it.
acceptance: An evaluation request on a claim in the committed flow may name, with a reason, a registered run of that claim whose verification record the host itself holds as terminally rejected by Engram. When that run's newest applicable terminal result passed eligibly and cleanly on the named root's current HEAD, the host records a disclosure note and admits the evaluation, with the run disclosed as context only and no verification credit. A behaviour test covers admission on a rejected record and refusal for a run whose result did not pass, whose commit is not HEAD, or whose record state is not the host's own Rejected. This assumes the run's launcher-written files (its request, results and other run files) are not rewritten or replaced by anything other than the launcher after the run's terminal write; defence against such rewrites is tracked as w-3c1dd299f0f6. If a newer matching registered run is unfinished, this disposition is refused until that run reaches a terminal result.

A criterion bound to a check kind is never satisfied by this disposition; the evaluator brief states the run carries no verification credit. A behaviour test asserts the brief's disclosure. docs/test.md documents the disposition beside the retired-check disposition.
